messages:
mira: Quick postmortem note: during the 03:12 UTC staggered rollout, a cold prefix for tenant=acme rehydrated and we observed duplicate apply records on two different shards. Small blast radius but scary for counters.

josh: ugh. concise logs? sounds like a handoff raced with rehydrate.

mira: snippet: ```[2026-03-23T03:12:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=sess-99 apply=ok node=shard-14
[2026-03-23T03:12:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=sess-99 apply=ok node=shard-6
[2026-03-23T03:12:08Z] tenant=acme prefix=sess-99 commit=ok node=shard-6```

leo: that pattern suggests shard-14 started rehydrate then ownership switched to shard-6 before demote/quiesce finished. double-apply window.

ana: two mitigation directions: make downstream ops tolerant (op-idempotency) or tighten handoff semantics (demote fence / ack). Both are valid but different scope.

josh: thoughts on a pragmatic staged approach: 1) add telemetry tags to rehydrate events (reason=cold|handoff|panic, latency_ms) so SLOs can detect drain-related spikes; 2) implement an opt-in demote-fence ops flag that blocks ownership transfer until either rehydrate completes or demote_ack_count >= N; 3) longer term, spec an idempotency contract for model-layer applies.

mira: +1. For short term I'd prefer the ops flag so we avoid rolling back rollout cadence. We can canary it in one region.

leo: Runtime idea: when a prefix is rehydrated within T seconds of a demote on its previous owner, mark it as "hot-handoff-probe" and route subsequent writes through a sequencer for a brief stabilization window. That gives strong safety with limited perf hit.

ana: Also add a synthetic test in the sim harness that forces an ownership flip during rehydrate and asserts no double-apply observable externally (either via idempotency or via blocking handoff). Rick/QA can own test.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling-upgrade shard-14 -> shard-6 completed 03:20 UTC :white_check_mark:

josh: action items: I'll draft a short RFC "rehydrate handoff handshake" describing demote-fence semantics, the sequencer-gate option, and idempotency contract recommendations. Mira will file incident note and coordinate SRE for ops-flag canary.

mira: will do. timeline: RFC draft by Tue EOD, ops canary request in parallel. Closing the thread for now.
